original_test_intent: Run the source level-4 DCGM Memtest and prove each GPU memory test passes without corrupting live data or creating ECC, XID, retirement, remap or availability regression.
original_method: Pin driver/DCGM and memtest script; identify each GPU and capture memory use, ECC/XID/retirement/remap state; define allocation/write patterns and destructive boundary; drain workloads, preserve logs, verify OOB; start service before invocation, set persistence if approved, run once under monitoring, compare all error/health state and recover contexts/services.
manual_activity: GPU reliability owner approves Memtest patterns, memory/destructive boundary and error disposition; operator drains all GPU contexts and owns OOB recovery.
required_inputs: Compatible GPU/driver/DCGM and level-4 Memtest documentation
Per-GPU memory capacity/use and data policy
Workload drain, OOB, monitoring and recovery
safety_requirements: Never run against live unapproved memory
Preserve full output and error counters
Do not clear or reset evidence
No automatic retry after memory fault
agent_execution_scope: Validate script, memory impact, baseline and approval
Prove workloads are drained and recovery ready
Evaluate every GPU/subtest and health delta
Restore runtime and report without verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its level-4 choice matches the source, but insecure access and omission of service order, workload isolation, baseline and recovery make it unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the pinned source level-4 Memtest only after the service is ready, all contexts are drained and per-GPU health/recovery gates pass.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Level 4, Memtest, 120-minute allocation and all-subtest PASS are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat Memtest as a potentially destructive memory operation with explicit patterns/regions, zero live contexts, per-GPU error deltas and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds script identity, write semantics, data safety, complete health oracle and correct service sequencing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Bandwidth results cannot substitute for pattern-based memory-integrity testing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Memtest may overwrite allocations, expose persistent errors or leave a GPU degraded.

project_override_considerations: Reliability engineering must specify allowed patterns/coverage and whether any new correctable ECC, page retirement or remap event is FAIL or quarantine.
expected_evidence: Pinned script hash and level-4 semantics
Complete Memtest output/exits and per-subtest results
